prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for careful precise construction reveal. Instruments: koto, soft synth bass, bamboo percussion. 108 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A light and upbeat instrumental track featuring a prominent plucked string melody, supported by a steady rhythm section and synth pads. It has a cheerful and slightly whimsical feel.
description.zh: 一首轻快活泼的纯音乐，以突出的拨弦旋律为主，配以稳定的节奏部分和合成器衬底。整体感觉欢快而略带奇思妙想。

description.en: A lively and whimsical instrumental track featuring a prominent plucked string melody, supported by a bright woodwind counter-melody and light, rhythmic percussion. It has a cheerful and playful folk-dance feel.
